chain.title: Threads of Brilliance
chain.desc: Place Brilliant Fiber on a tree canopy and let the transformation spread through its leaves. Start with a tree you can reach safely so collecting the finished leaves is straightforward.

chain.title: Bottle and Cork
chain.desc: A glass bottle and a plank. Right-click the open air with it to catch Aura; a dispenser will do the job for you.

chain.title: Rose of Oblivion
chain.desc: Follow the guide's End expedition to find the Rose of Oblivion. Learn its Aura-generation method before planting it as the supply for an expensive new workshop.

chain.title: Something Left Over From a Birth
chain.desc: Breed suitable animals in an area with the Aura conditions described by the guide and collect Spirits of Birthing. Keep the breeding area supplied rather than expecting every ordinary birth to produce one.
chain.acquisition: Breed passive animals in an area with excess Aura; the breeding event can spawn Spirits of Birthing as item drops.

chain.title: Harvest the Brilliant Tree
chain.desc: Harvest the transformed Golden Leaves for Gold Leaf. Keep enough for ritual materials and Wooden Stands before turning the rest into powder.

chain.title: Sunlight, Ghosts and Darkness
chain.desc: Use the Bottle and Cork to collect Aura in the dimension required by your recipe. Bottled Aura retains its type, so an Overworld bottle is not automatically a substitute for a Nether or End bottle.
chain.acquisition: Use a Bottle and Cork in the air to collect Aura. The filled item is an Aura Bottle carrying the dimension-specific stored type.

chain.title: Bricks Shot Through With Gold
chain.desc: Stone bricks and Brilliant Fiber. Both catalysts are built on a frame of these.

chain.title: Crushed to Dust
chain.desc: Use Gold Powder to lay out the Ritual of the Forest exactly as the guide shows. Leave room for the sapling and ingredient stands rather than squeezing the ritual into a normal crafting corner.

chain.title: Stands Around the Circle
chain.desc: Set Wooden Stands in the ritual arrangement and place the selected recipe ingredients on them. The growing tree completes the ritual; prepare the recipe before triggering its growth.

chain.title: Carved From Gladness
chain.desc: Complete the Token of Joy tree ritual with the correct bottled Aura and ingredients. Save a token for the Natural Altar instead of using every early token on side projects.

chain.title: See What Is Not There
chain.desc: Use the Environmental Eye to inspect local Aura while operating the altar. If the area is running low, address the supply before adding more machines to the same workshop.

chain.title: Seed of an Older Forest
chain.desc: Complete the tree ritual for an Ancient Sapling and grow it in a clear area. Keep a renewable supply of the wood for the rods and tools that require Ancient materials.

chain.title: Where Nature Is Infused
chain.desc: Create the Natural Altar through the Ritual of the Forest, then build its supporting multiblock. It draws Aura from the surrounding area; plan a replenishment source before running repeated infusions.

chain.title: A Stick With History
chain.desc: Split from Ancient Slabs. Every finder, the Staff of Baldur and the Ender Ocular are built around one.

chain.title: Iron That Drank the Air
chain.desc: An iron ingot left on the Natural Altar until the surrounding Aura soaks into it. The mod's working metal.

chain.title: Rock, Similarly Treated
chain.desc: Stone infused on the altar. It builds the catalysts, the Aura Cache and most of the mod's machinery.

chain.title: Gold, Spoiled
chain.desc: Place gold on a working Natural Altar and wait for the Tainted Gold infusion. This recipe consumes Aura over time; deliberately exhausting the area is not a prerequisite.

chain.title: A Pocket Full of Aura
chain.desc: Charge the Aura Cache and carry it to supply supported equipment. Watch its stored amount while testing a trinket so you know how quickly your usual activities drain it.

chain.title: The Altar Learns to Grind
chain.desc: Build the Crushing Catalyst and place it in the altar arrangement shown by the guide. Test a supported crushing recipe to confirm that the catalyst is positioned correctly.

chain.title: A Voice That Reaches Up
chain.desc: Bring together Infused Iron, Tainted Gold and the required Aura bottle types to make a Spirit of Calling. This connects your altar workshop with the offering branch.

chain.title: Offering to the Gods
chain.desc: Arrange the Offering Table and its required surroundings according to the guide. Prepare both the offering items and a Spirit of Calling before attempting an exchange.

chain.title: What the Sky Sends Back
chain.desc: Use the offering process to obtain Ingots of the Skies. Reserve the first supply for the Conversion Catalyst or another planned upgrade instead of scattering it across unfinished projects.

chain.title: Joy, Made Greater
chain.desc: Offer a Token of Joy and the gods return its stronger form. Each of the four base tokens has such an exchange.

chain.title: The Altar Learns to Transmute
chain.desc: Use Ingots of the Skies to prepare the Conversion Catalyst. Add it to the altar setup and check the newly available conversions before committing valuable materials.

chain.title: Pressed Into the Deep
chain.desc: Combine Ingots of the Skies, Tainted Gold and the remaining listed ingredients into the deeper metal tier. Choose a specific late tool or device before spending the first ingots.

chain.title: The Ocular
chain.desc: The Environmental Eye rebuilt by ritual with a Rose of Oblivion and an Ingot of the Skies; it reads far more than Aura level.

chain.title: Altar of Birthing
chain.desc: Prepare the Altar of Birthing with the correct offerings and a Spirit of Birthing. Give the resulting creature a safe enclosure before starting the process.

chain.title: Ring of Last Chance
chain.desc: Craft the Ring of Last Chance with the required advanced tokens and Aura materials. Keep its Aura supply available and read the limitations before treating it as reliable emergency protection.

notes: Reviewed against the primary sources listed above. Every chain row now declares its intended prerequisites; an empty list is an intentional independent starting point. The order is topological. Item and checkpoint-icon asset paths and typed objective identifiers were checked against the listed jar or source snapshot. Jar inspection verifies identifiers and selected mechanics, not that every route has been completed in game.

sources.scope: English guide/tooltip text, recipe data and inventory assets; selected special mechanics checked against implementation.

coverage.scope: Tree rituals, Aura-aware altar operation, offering exchanges, ancient wood and late devices.
coverage.limits: A curated teaching route, not every item or mechanic. Recipe quantities and conditions follow the installed pack. Manual checkpoints require player confirmation. No complete in-game playthrough claimed.
